assumptions: Sources are committed work and the base is an ancestor of every source.
The registered workspace repository root equals the repository the agents inspect.
Agent-reported command results match what the commands produced.
The host permission allowlist of REQ-016 is in force; it is recorded by host receipts, not verified by the script.
assurance.domain: Committed Git work of at most 32 operations in one registered analysis-only workspace; replay and prepare only for 2 to 4 operations.
assurance.evidenceMethod: Existing read-only analyzer report through plugin MCP analyze-work, git merge-tree --write-tree baseline in a temporary object directory, and replay evidence through plugin MCP analyze; commands are executed by agents and returned under strict schemas, not independently re-run by the script.
assurance.executionContract: Read-only analysis and a non-allocating prepare step; no grant, execution, edit, ref write or applied merge; executionAuthorization is false.
assurance.observationContract: Pinned base and source commit identifiers, analyzer coverage and interaction classes, per-pair merge-tree result, replay digests, prepare outcome and end-of-run reference re-resolution; absent observations are null and never mean clean.
assurance.property: File-level interaction classes and pairwise merge-tree outcomes over committed work; not semantic commutation, hunk-level merge safety or order independence.

limits: File-level resources only; coarser than hunk merging; a read plus a write on one resource counts as conflicting.
Reads are not observed; read hazards are outside this gate.
Only committed work is observed; uncommitted work in any worktree is not observed.
Deletions, renames, binaries and symlinks are unknown effects with partial coverage.
Replay, preparation and the owned runtime are limited to four operations; analysis is limited to 32.
No speed, throughput or agent-count claim; parallel runtime speedup results are recorded NO-GO (SPEC-021 G4, SPEC-022, SPEC-038).
Host approval and auto mode are not authority; executionAuthorization is false; grants are issued by the operator outside the workflow.
An independent-candidate, clean or certified outcome is not a guarantee of semantic correctness, conflict freedom or order independence.
Command results are reported by agents under strict schemas; the script checks their shape and consistency but does not re-run them.
The host permission allowlist is not observable by the script; a refusal of runtime-enabled registrations and an agent-reported tool list are defensive checks, not enforcement.

phases.detail: source-equals-base: the source resolves to the base commit; it adds no work and the analyzer would report it as independent
phases.name: validate

refusal.message: the source resolves to the base commit; it adds no work and the analyzer would report it as independent
